reference_audit.request: Recheck upstream references and the dual-radio idle acceptance rule.
acceptance: Both radios never configured: available without creating or enabling an AP.
All AP/STA disabled: available, including inert runtime interface remnants.
Failed attempt retry: no previous artifact path, creation marker, completed recovery object or overlapping worker reused.
Concurrent startup: real monitor preparation precedes placeholders; only registered, correctly marked matching-PHY placeholders are removed.
findings: Paramiko exit_status_ready is true for a closed channel even without a server exit status. Negative exit status cannot authorize an automatic fallback.
Unexpected stream EOF or read error must retain an error rather than report an ordinary stop.
Pending final channel data must be consumed before interpreting exit, with bounded reads and memory.
Capture pre-exec safe retry also recognizes the upstream Channel is not open error; command-submission failure is never blindly retried.
Final process cleanup now checks comm, exact interface argument and non-zombie status before each signal; unreadable identity refuses confirmation.
hcxdumptool 6.3.4 -L returns before set_interface; close_fds/close_sockets/close_lists do not modify interfaces.
IFF_UP is administrative state, not proof of receiving frames; the initial observation window is not described as full hardware compatibility.
